source.description: Preflights manifest-backed class atoms and canonical grid inputs, runs fully bound child atom tools through the shared runner, renders final component bytes, and verifies planned files.

result.name: component name
result.dependencies: optional child tool receipts when missing atom dependencies were created
result.id: positive numeric ID from the shared owner
result.title: generated child React component title

settings.name: generated item name
settings.title: generated title
settings.class: present only when a class remains after resolution
settings.grid: present only when a grid was selected

result.construction_seats: optional area seats for component population
